tool.name: PIMENTO Generate base-conservation vector(s)
tool.command: #if $strand_flags ## Derive the strand(s) from a trimming-conductor flags file ## (2 lines: forward flag, reverse flag; each one of none/std/auto - ## the MGnify amplicon pipeline's PRIMER_IDENTIFICATION output). ## Only strands flagged 'auto' get a BCV, as in the pipeline's ## PIMENTO_GENERATEBCV; if neither is 'auto' an empty file is ## produced (the pipeline touches an empty <prefix>_mcp_cons.tsv). fwd_flag=\$(sed -n 1p '$strand_flags') && rev_flag=\$(sed -n 2p '$strand_flags') && if [ "\$fwd_flag" = 'auto' ] && [ "\$rev_flag" = 'auto' ]; then strand='FR'; elif [ "\$fwd_flag" = 'auto' ]; then strand='F'; elif [ "\$rev_flag" = 'auto' ]; then strand='R'; else strand=''; fi && if [ -z "\$strand" ]; then touch sample_bcv.tsv; else pimento gen_bcv -i '$input_fastq' -st "\$strand" -o sample; fi #else pimento gen_bcv -i '$input_fastq' -st $strand -o sample #end if

param.name: input_fastq
param.label: Input reads to generate the BCV for

param.name: strand
param.label: The strand(s) to generate a BCV for
param.help: Ignored when a trimming-conductor flags file is provided below

param.name: strand_flags
param.label: Trimming-conductor flags file (optional)
param.help: 2-line file with the forward and reverse primer-trimming flags (none/std/auto) as produced by the MGnify amplicon pipeline's primer identification; only strands flagged 'auto' get a base-conservation vector, and an empty output is produced when neither is 'auto'

tool.help: Generates base-conservation vector(s) for input fastq files. To be used by the primer cutoff inference strategy, this function computes the base- conservation vector for input reads. Users can choose to perform this computation for either forward or reverse strands of the reads, or both.
